paragraphs: The 840d xDrive uses the B57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with 48-volt mild hybrid assistance. It was introduced with the current-generation 8 Series (G14/G15/G16) in 2018 and remains in production. The B57 is BMW's modular diesel engine family, sharing its architecture with the petrol B58, and features a closed-deck block for strength and a compact exhaust aftertreatment system close to the engine for faster light-off. A low-pressure exhaust gas recirculation system and stepped combustion process contribute to clean-running efficiency.
about.boldParagraph: The 840d xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
